accepted_text: Adepte de l’islam (nom masculin ; féminin : musulmane).

reason: Adepte de l’islam matches source Adepte and EN/ZH. The proposed pratique requires observance beyond affiliation; the exact replacement removes that narrower implication. Exact musulman/NOM is a masculine adherent of Islam; the feminine musulmane is attested. Adherence, not nationality or a minimum level of religious practice, defines this person noun.
